seoTitle: Image Histogram Viewer (RGB and Luminance, Clipping Check)
metaDescription: Draw the red, green, blue and luminance histograms of a photo and see how many pixels are crushed to black or blown to white, to judge exposure.
intro: See the RGB and luminance histogram of a photo.
why:
Choose a photo and the page draws the red, green, blue and luminance histograms and reports how much of the picture is clipped to black or white.

The left edge of the chart is black and the right edge is white. A big spike at either end means lost detail. Some pictures are meant to be bright or dark, so look at the photo as well.
